    - heading "Understand Sine Rule" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "The sine rule links sides of a triangle with sines of opposite angles. In Sine Rule, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples.     - heading "Worked Example (One Solution)" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Solve triangle ABC where a = 10, b = 7, A = 45°.
    - list:
      - text: "Use the Sine Rule to find B:"
      - strong:
        - text: sin B = b sin A / a = 7 sin 45° / 10 = 0.49497
        - text: B = 29.7° or 180° − 29.7° = 150.3°
      - listitem: "Take the acute angle for a valid triangle: B ≈ 29.7°"
      - listitem: "Find C: C = 180° − 45° − 29.7° = 105.3°"
      - listitem: "Find c: c = a sin C / sin A = 10 sin 105.3° / sin 45° = 13.64"
    - generic: "Answer: B ≈ 29.7°, C ≈ 105.3°, c ≈ 13.64"
